description: Set, list, snooze, stop and remove a person's own reminders on OpenVibe.Today, for that person (plan L48): a first-party service such as OpenVibe.Chat's Vibe names the person with X-OV-Subject, and every route answers only that person's reminders. A reminder is plain words parsed by Today ("stretch every 2 hours from 9 to 5") and keeps the https link and the source site that set it.
